rule: FL-M5 T8: ONNX reranker on ret-test, fixed before the one ret-test run
queries: all 1,137 ret-test queries, FL-M3's candidates.test.jsonl (filtered dense top 50)
chosen_on_dev_because: fastest ONNX variant on ret-dev with parity: forward p50 202.17 ms vs 211.65 ms (torch-cuda-fp16), NDCG@10 0.4879 vs 0.488, recall@10 and MRR@10 equal, same top 10 on 167 of 182 queries

checks.export_matches: abs(metric of candidate_variant - metric of reference_variant) <= match_tolerance for every metric in match_metrics

tolerance_basis: largest NDCG@10 gap between an fp16 ONNX variant and torch-cuda-fp16 on ret-dev: 0.0009
dev_only: all CPU variants (1,137 queries on the CPU would take hours) and the unfused ONNX variants
commands: ~/venvs/fl-train/bin/python -m filinglens.serve.onnx_reranker score --split test --allow-test --engine torch --device cuda --dtype fp16 --note "<power mode>"
PYTHONPATH=src ~/venvs/fl-onnx/bin/python -m filinglens.serve.onnx_reranker score --split test --allow-test --engine ort --device cuda --graph eager-opt-fp16 --note "<power mode>"
uv run python -m filinglens.serve.onnx_reranker compare --split test --allow-test
